name: button
title: Button
description: The one button for every action. Primary for the main action of a view, secondary for everything else, ghost for low-emphasis actions in toolbars, danger for destructive actions.
whenToUse: Any clickable action. Use one primary button per view or dialog. Use an <a class="tx-btn"> only when it navigates.

variants.description: Main action. Brand fill, lifts to the menu-bar colour on hover.
Default action. Card surface, line border, gold on hover.
Low emphasis, no border until hover.
28px high, for tables and dense toolbars.
Full width, for narrow forms and mobile.

a11y: Use <button type="button"> (or type="submit" in forms). Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Disabled state uses the disabled attribute, not a class.
